name: Verdnt
tagline: The operating system for indoor crop production at scale
positioning: Verdnt gives enterprise growers unified control over climate, nutrients, and yield forecasting across every vertical farm in their network.

hero.h1: Every tier, every crop, one control plane
hero.sub: Verdnt connects the climate loops, dosing systems, and harvest data across your indoor farms so operations teams can hit yield targets without living inside a spreadsheet.

features.title: Recipe orchestration
features.description: Version and roll out light, temperature, and nutrient recipes to thousands of grow zones, then watch actual conditions drift against target in real time.

features.title: Yield forecasting
features.description: Model harvest weight and DLI-adjusted timing per rack, so your sales team can commit to grocery contracts weeks before transplant.

features.title: Anomaly response
features.description: Verdnt flags a failing dosing pump or a stalled airflow fan before the canopy shows stress, and routes the alert to the on-shift technician.

features.title: Compliance records
features.description: Automatically log every input, batch, and lot for GAP and food-safety audits, exportable the moment an inspector asks.

features.title: Energy accounting
features.description: Attribute kWh and water use down to the tray to find which cultivars actually pencil out at commercial volume.

features.title: Multi-site rollout
features.description: Standardize a proven farm blueprint and clone it to a new facility, with local overrides for utility rates and labor shifts.

testimonials.quote: We were running three farms on three different SCADA setups. Verdnt gave our agronomists one dashboard, and we cut crop loss from environmental faults by nearly a third in two quarters.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

testimonials.quote: The forecasting is what sold our board. We can now tell a retail buyer exactly how many cases of basil ship in week nine, and we hit it.
testimonials.name: Daniel Osei

testimonials.quote: Audit prep used to eat a full week per facility. With Verdnt's batch records it's a same-day export, and our food-safety lead finally sleeps.
testimonials.name: Helena Vogt
